---
title: "Pullquote Test: Text Alignment"
---

## Inner Text Alignment

This tests the alignment of the text *inside* the pullquote box, independently of where the box itself floats on the page.

```markdown
::: {.pullquote align="pq-align-left"}
This text is forced to align to the left edge of the pullquote box.
:::
```

::: {.pullquote align="pq-align-left"}
This text is forced to align to the left edge of the pullquote box.
:::

```markdown
::: {.pullquote align="pq-align-center"}
This text is centered perfectly within the pullquote box.
:::
```

::: {.pullquote align="pq-align-center"}
This text is centered perfectly within the pullquote box.
:::

```markdown
::: {.pullquote align="pq-align-right"}
This text is flushed to the right edge of the pullquote box.
:::
```

::: {.pullquote align="pq-align-right"}
This text is flushed to the right edge of the pullquote box.
:::
